limitations: Static source and test/fixture semantic review only; no test suite, build, real browser service, runtime deployment, paid model, MCP or credential-dependent validation was run under the audit gate.
No confirmed actionable defect required an isolated offline candidate probe; no probes were run.

No live visual/browser-engine behavior or external backend/service availability was established. Clean denotes no confirmed actionable finding in the fully read frozen Web partition, not a claim that all runtime behaviors are defect-free.
conclusion: All 202 frozen Web files were fully reviewed; no confirmed actionable finding. Both independent raw checks matched all 1911 sources and the pinned snapshots matched the frozen digest.

methodDetails.review: Fresh independent read-only semantic audit of every file in frozen groups.web; no prior-round findings or historical audits used.
methodDetails.reading: Read complete literal file contents with Get-Content, splitting long files into contiguous ranges. Re-read truncated/unavailable output ranges before counting a file. File enumeration, line/byte counts and SHA checks were coverage/integrity aids only, never substitutes for full semantic reading.
implementationReview: App and Workspace initialization, authentication transitions, navigation, thread readiness and selected-owner lifetime.

All hooks and libraries: bounded async resource loading, events, history/timeline reconciliation, current-generation fences, draft retention and failure behavior, durable operation admission, receipts and no replay.

Every component: forms, explicit permissions and confirmation binding, MCP authorization and tools, provider configuration, account settings, import/media, runtime diagnostics, automation and task flows, process/terminal/realtime ownership, Git and workspace recovery.
Every stylesheet and build/browser configuration: visible/hidden controls, focus and responsive layouts, safe rendering and display budgets.
Every test and fixture: actual setup/mocking/cleanup, async sequencing, assertions, failure/recovery cases and contract alignment with the current implementation. Tests were read, not executed.
methodDetails.independence: No Git history, old repository, prior audit reports, WORKLOG or old .work analysis was opened. Frozen web/VERIFICATION.md was read as an in-scope source document; its embedded earlier-phase prose was not adopted as evidence, and no linked historical reports were opened.
methodDetails.sourceAccess: Source files remained read-only; writes were limited to this reviewer current-round .work evidence/report artifacts.
methodDetails.integrity: Independently recomputed raw SHA-256 for every one of the 1911 frozen source files before and after review, and ran the pinned Node scripts/snapshot.mjs at both boundaries.
